evidence_quotes.quote: GU Original Energy Gel box of 24 x 32 g packets (768 g net) retailing at $48.00 USD on guenergy.com.
Per 32 g packet (Tri-Berry): 100 kcal, 23 g total carbs (7 g sugars), 0 g fat, 0 g protein, 55 mg sodium, 30 mg potassium, 20 mg caffeine, 450 mg BCAA blend (L-Leucine, L-Valine, L-Isoleucine).
Informed Choice certified, vegan, gluten-free, kosher.
